query:
SELECT l.scorer,
               count(*) AS "labelled!",
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE (s.score >= $2) = l.passed) AS "agreed!"
        FROM factory_run r
        JOIN factory_scorer_label l ON l.run_id = r.id
        JOIN factory_run_score s ON s.run_id = l.run_id AND s.scorer = l.scorer
        WHERE r.user_id = $1
        GROUP BY l.scorer
        ORDER BY l.scorer
